svg.title: coderprint: 355k lines of code in use, of 527k written, all time
svg.desc: 354,743 lines of code in use (182,480 in production, 172,263 in tests), of 527,305 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 1,538 commits across all branches, 38 active days, a longest streak of 23 days, a current streak of 23 days, and 4 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 452k lines of code. The bars end on 29SEP2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 62%, Python 16%, TypeScript 14%, JavaScript 7%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 67% is kept.
